configurePresets.name: wsl-release
configurePresets.description: Release build under Windows Subsystem for Linux. The build tree deliberately goes under $HOME, never next to a source tree that may be on /mnt/c: compiling on a Windows drive is 10-50x slower and cmake/WSL.cmake rejects it.

configurePresets.name: wsl-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build under WSL. -O0 plus USE_PRECONDITIONS; see CLAUDE.md section 8 for why probes belong in a debug build.

buildPresets.name: wsl-release
buildPresets.description: Translation starts one JVM per .foo file. If the VM is short of memory, override with: cmake --build --preset wsl-release -- -j2

testPresets.name: wsl-short
testPresets.description: The short suite -- the same set GitHub Actions gates on.
